title: Голубой риф VR
elevatorPitch: Ребёнок в линзовых VR-очках парит над солнечным коралловым рифом и просто осматривается: мимо проплывают рыбы, колышутся кораллы, а вдали плывёт кит.
playerFantasy: Спокойно попасть под воду и разглядывать живой риф, крутя головой
audience: children 4-8 and their parents; mobile browser in lens VR glasses
coreLoop: осмотреться: рыбы, кораллы, водоросли, столбы света
perspective: first person, static diver position in a reef clearing, free head look
sessionLength: endless loop; exit by removing the glasses or leaving the page
controls: head look via camera colour markers (single / dual)
flat preview: pointer drag look and 'look straight' reset
progression: none: no score, no timer, no loss
visualDirection: sunny shallow reef: bright turquoise water, god rays, caustics on sand and fish, dense coral gardens, volumetric depth fog, soft bloom outside VR; three.js procedural geometry; 'AAA' as an art-direction target, not a certified production claim
mustHave: Stereo pair rendering for lens glasses without WebXR, adjustable baseline 10-150 cm
Head look from camera colour markers only: modes 'marker', 'dual marker', 'forward'
Look limits +/-70 deg yaw, +/-45 deg pitch; hold last look when the marker is lost
Prep screen: camera preview, colour picker per box, 'looking straight' calibration, quality preset
Sunny shallow reef: sand seabed with caustics, coral gardens, kelp, god rays, marine snow
Six-plus fish species including dense schools, plus distant whale that approaches periodically
PWA with offline cache; manual quality presets; test bridge for automated QA
outOfScope: Joystick, gestures, tapping, or any gameplay control
Motion of the diver through the world (static clearing by contract)
acceptanceCriteria: Stereo pair starts only after an explicit user action and renders two square viewports
Baseline slider 10-150 cm changes eye separation and persists
Look modes are separate: camera marker mode never uses the gyroscope
Yaw clamped to +/-70 deg and pitch to +/-45 deg in every look mode
Lost marker holds the last look and does not drift to centre
Dual-marker calibration requires both boxes and stores per-marker reference angles
Fish, corals, kelp and the whale are present and animate over time
Whale periodically approaches closer and retreats
Quality presets change resolution, fish counts, particles and effects measurably
Pause on visibility change; no unhandled errors; PWA installs and reloads offline
Automated QA suites pass and results are stored in .studio/evidence/

technical.deployment: Static build, GitHub Pages compatible, no bundler
